query: I'm putting together a new athletic outfit and need a few specific pieces. First, I'm looking for a 'Crewneck Top' that can arrive quickly, so the transport time must be less than 2 days. It needs to be well-reviewed, with an average score over 4.5, more than 40 four-star reviews, and fewer than 15 three-star reviews. To complement that, I want a very popular item for women from the brand Ralph Lauren. Specifically, it must be Pink, size L, and have over 1000 five-star ratings. Lastly, to complete the set, I need some 'Performance Tights' from Puma in size L. I'm looking for quality, so they must have an average score greater than 4.5 and more than 150 four-star ratings.
